name: Intra-corporate transfer permit (przeniesienie wewnątrz przedsiębiorstwa, ICT)

requirements.blocker_text: Managers and specialists must have been employed continuously within the same company or corporate group for at least 12 months immediately before the transfer (6 months for trainees).
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 12 months (6 for trainees) of continuous employment with the sending entity before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: The Polish receiving entity must be capital- or organisationally-linked to the foreign sending employer (same corporate group), and files the application before the transferee's arrival.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm the Polish entity and the sending employer belong to the same corporate group.

requirements.blocker_text: Managers and specialists must document professional qualifications or experience matching the receiving role; trainees must hold a relevant university degree.
requirements.fix_path: Provide qualification or degree documentation matching the transferred role.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 12 (or 6) months' continuous prior employment within the group
Assignment letter and intra-group linkage documentation
Qualification or degree documentation matching the role

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years for managers/specialists, up to 1 year for trainees
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: must be outside all EU member states at the time of the first application (does not apply to renewals from within the EU)

sources.title: biznes.gov.pl (official Polish government business portal) -- Zezwolenie na pobyt czasowy w celu wykonywania pracy w ramach przeniesienia wewnątrz przedsiębiorstwa (ICT)
Urząd do Spraw Cudzoziemców (Office for Foreigners) -- Przeniesienie wewnątrz przedsiębiorstwa (ICT), corroborating the pre-application EU-external-residence condition
Lubuski Urząd Wojewódzki (regional government office, BIP public-information portal) -- ICT long-term mobility conditions, independent cross-check of the receiving-entity and duration rules

notes: Not renewable within Poland in the ordinary sense -- ICT permits are capped at a hard 3-year (manager/specialist) or 1-year (trainee) ceiling regardless of extensions, per biznes.gov.pl, which is a structurally different cap-shape from the Single Permit's renewable 3-year cycles. A distinct 'long-term mobility' sub-permit exists for ICT-card holders who were first posted to another EU state and want to extend the assignment to Poland for over 90 days -- not separately encoded as its own route file here since it is a mobility extension of an ICT status granted elsewhere, not an independent entry route into Poland; flagged for a future outcome_override if this dataset later needs to model intra-EU ICT mobility chains explicitly. This route sits alongside pl_single_permit as Poland's other main employer-sponsored channel, distinguished by requiring genuine corporate-group linkage and prior tenure rather than an open-market job offer -- the standard OR-vs-AND split the schema is designed to hold without needing group-level overrides here, since ICT and Single Permit are legally and administratively separate permit types rather than alternate qualifying groups within one permit.
